EPrint third-party acknowledgements

The project MIT license does not replace the licenses of these components.
The current Gradle source configures this directory as APK assets. Verify the
actual notices and licenses in any APK before distributing that APK.
The full inventory is in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the source repository.

MNN 3.6.1, including MNN Express, MNN LLM, headers and the JNI implementation reference:
Copyright Alibaba Group Holding Limited. Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/alibaba/MNN/tree/3.6.1
EPrint modifies the JNI session wrapper, streaming, cancellation and metrics.
MNN third-party components retain their own copyright and license notices.
The shipped libllm binary contains cpp-httplib and jinja symbol names.
MNN 3.6.1 source identifies cpp-httplib 0.26.0, Copyright (c) 2025 Yuji Hirose,
MIT License; the upstream LICENSE also credits Copyright (c) 2017 yhirose.
See MNN-cpp-httplib-0.26.0.txt. The binary's exact httplib version is unverified.
jinja.cpp 0.0.1, https://github.com/wangzhaode/jinja.cpp, Apache License 2.0.
Skia-derived Matrix.h / Rect.h retain Copyright 2006 The Android Open Source
Project and BSD notices; see their original headers and MNN-Skia.txt.
Halide-derived runtime declarations retain MIT notices in Halide-reference-v14.txt;
MNN does not record the original imported Halide revision. This license reference
does not establish that the imported code came from Halide v14.

JSON for Modern C++ 3.11.3:
Copyright (c) 2013-2023 Niels Lohmann. MIT License.
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3

LLVM libc++ runtime supplied with MNN:
Apache License 2.0 with LLVM Exceptions and the notices in LLVM-libcxx.txt.

PaddleOCR models and RapidOCR model conversion/reference implementation:
Copyright PaddlePaddle Authors and RapidOCR Authors. Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR

AndroidX and AndroidX Test: The Android Open Source Project. Apache License 2.0.
ZXing and ZXing Android Embedded: ZXing Authors and Journey Mobile / JourneyApps.
Apache License 2.0; see the corresponding license files for additional notices.
ONNX Runtime: Copyright Microsoft Corporation. MIT License and ThirdPartyNotices.
OpenCV: Copyright OpenCV contributors. Apache License 2.0 and component notices.
The OpenCV Android arm64 binary reports linked cpufeatures, Protobuf, ADE,
oneTBB, Intel ITT, libjpeg-turbo, libwebp, libpng, libtiff, OpenJPEG, OpenEXR,
Carotene/Tegra HAL, and builtin FlatBuffers. See the OpenCV-* license files.
OpenCV-vendored ITT permits either BSD or GPLv2; the BSD option is used here.
Its complete source header credits Copyright (c) 2005-2014 Intel Corporation;
see OpenCV-ITT-source-header.txt as well as OpenCV-ITT-BSD.txt.
The complete oneTBB v2021.11.0 third-party-programs.txt is also preserved as
OpenCV-oneTBB-2021.11.0-ThirdPartyPrograms.txt, including all license conditions
and the GCC Runtime Library Exception. This is a whole-release inventory;
it does not establish that every listed component is linked into this binary
or that the presence of GPL text makes GPL terms applicable to EPrint.
This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.
See native_components.json for binary hashes, build information, source evidence
and limitations. Tagged source licenses do not reconstruct exact binary inputs.

Test-only dependencies, including JUnit, Hamcrest and JSON-java, retain their
own licenses and are not app runtime components; see dependencies.json.
